name: RoboReward / RoboRewardBench

summaryEn: Robot rollout videos paired with task instructions and end-of-episode progress rewards.

wmNote: 由 OXE、RoboArena 等派生；任务重标注与时间裁剪不构成新的独立物理干预。
wmNoteEn: Derived from OXE and RoboArena; instruction relabeling and temporal clipping do not constitute new physical interventions.

evidence.locator: Dataset description; Splits and size; Fields
evidence.statement: Each example includes a real-robot rollout video, task instruction and terminal progress score. Temporal clipping creates partial-outcome examples; the test subset is RoboRewardBench. Inclusion concerns observed execution outcomes, not causal intervention claims.
